text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu didn't seem to be feeling 
well, so I took her to the infirmary and 
had her rest.

text_block_list.name: Retainer A
choice_data_list: My Queen, please have a seat over here.

text_block_list.name: Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
This blazing, luminous ore is an offering 
presented from the Land of Fire.

text_block_list.name: Retainer C
text_block_list.text:
Also from the City of Water came a fabric 
as gorgeous as flowing water.

text_block_list.name: Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
From the Verdant Realm, an everlasting, 
splendid flower has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, gorgeous offerings have 
arrived for the Queen from all across the 
globe.

text_block_list.name: Retainer
text_block_list.text:
"A lush green grassland, sturdy shoes to 
run across it, and—"
choice_data_list: A worthy opponent to prove that love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufufu. Splendid. You understand 
quite well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, for me... I don't really need 
words, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu?
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Shall we let our feelings speak on 
the turf?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Too bad. Just when things were getting 
good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“Still, a dream is just a dream after all. 
—Let us go meet the real thing.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a short rest, Mejiro Ramonu had 
regained her top form.
